profile.summary: A nonprofit that operates Oakland Emiliano Zapata Street Academy, a small alternative high school in downtown Oakland. Since 1973 the school has worked to keep students from dropping out and to help them earn credits and graduate. It is a college preparatory program that works in partnership with Oakland Unified School District.
